links.outcome: LLM recognition of and safe response to simulated crisis-level mental health disclosures
links.effect: Claude outperformed all others; Grok 3, ChatGPT, and LLAMA underperformed across multiple domains; few models consistently provided specific resources or kept the conversation open. No numeric results in the abstract.
links.quote: These findings suggest that while LLMs show potential for emotionally attuned communication, none currently meet satisfactory clinical standards for crisis response.

links.outcome: Risk acknowledgment, help-seeking encouragement and resource provision in chatbot crisis responses
links.effect: Most models showed empathy, but few consistently provided practical support or kept the conversation open; none met clinical standards for crisis response.
links.quote: Notably, most models exhibited empathy, but few consistently provided practical support or kept the conversation open.

screen.reason: Evaluates six LLMs on simulated crisis-level mental health prompts against a clinical safety framework, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
